sites.source: parks.ca.gov campground map (sites 1-129) + ReserveCalifornia (30-ft unit max on every site), read 2026-11-27

note: Giant-sequoia park on Hwy 4 near Arnold, with two campgrounds. North Grove (sites 1-74) is by the park entrance and visitor center. Oak Hollow (sites 75-129) is ~4 mi in on the Parkway. Pads are gravel back-ins. Snow every winter. The Ebbetts Pass approach from the east is too steep and twisting for RVs; come in from Arnold. --Claude
summary: parks.ca.gov page, 11/2026 infosheet, campground map and ReserveCalifornia read: $35, 30-ft max, no hookups, pay showers, seasonal dump. In winter only North Grove 1-11 stay open, first-come and dry; the Parkway (Oak Hollow) is closed Nov 16 to ~May 1, a normal seasonal closure. Open; not waterfront kept, with a possible creekside flag. Oak Hollow is a split candidate.
flags: SPLIT CANDIDATE: Oak Hollow Campground is a separate place ~1.6 km east of North Grove (OSM way 92797777, centroid 38.27311,-120.2907; ~4 mi by the Parkway). It has its own loops, sites 75-129: 55 numbered, 18 RV 'Campsite' plus 30 tent units on ReserveCalifornia facility 349, $35, 30-ft max, its own restrooms and showers. It closes with the Parkway in winter. Booking: https://www.reservecalifornia.com (Calaveras Big Trees SP > Oak Hollow Campground). North Grove (sites 1-74, facilities 344/346/348) would stay on this entry.

WATERFRONT: stored 'not waterfront' left as stored. The campground map draws Big Tree Creek along North Grove sites ~13-27, between the site row and the open meadow. The creek's width and flow are unknown and the canopy hides it in imagery, so a creekside value is unconfirmed and I'm not recommending one. Possible creekside for AWH if the creek runs in season.

ACCESS: parks.ca.gov says the eastern approach over Ebbetts Pass (Hwy 4 from US 395) is 'so steep and tortuous that trailers and large motorhomes are ill-advised to use it'. That is the route from the east only; the western approach from Arnold/Angels Camp is the normal one. I'm not treating it as a drop. The note now says to come in from Arnold.
PIN 38.27850,-120.30720 is by the visitor center at the edge of North Grove (sites 1-11 adjoin it on the map). It's well under 250 m from the loop, so no move.
PHONE 209-795-2334 and the website are confirmed. Prescribed burns are planned (2026-09-21 notice); no closure is posted beyond the normal winter one.
